description: Review existing Rust code for idiom, API design, error handling, safety, and maintainability, and produce a prioritized report where every finding cites the rule it breaks and gives a concrete fix. Use this whenever the user asks to review, audit, critique, grade, or "check" Rust code, a crate, a module, a .rs file, a diff, or a pull request, or asks what is wrong with their Rust or how to make it more idiomatic, even if they don't say "review". Pairs with the rust-best-practices skill, which covers writing new code.
